fields.acceptance: A testscript queues a request with --milestone <handle> and sees the milestone's ID in request ls --json; --milestone naming an intent with no milestone field, or an unknown node, exits with a usage error and queues nothing
fields.statement: rhiza request (and the request op) takes an optional --milestone naming a milestone intent by handle or ID, refuses with a usage error one that is not a live milestone intent, stores its ID on the request and shows it in request ls

fields.acceptance: A testscript starts the plan run of a request queued with --milestone (run start --request, with a fake agent that prints its environment) and sees RHIZA_MILESTONE set to the milestone's ID; for a request without --milestone it is unset
fields.statement: The plan run of a request that names a milestone hands that milestone to the planner: its interview step's environment carries RHIZA_MILESTONE with the milestone's ID, absent when the request names none

fields.acceptance: internal/guide plan_test asserts the plan guide names RHIZA_MILESTONE, says the serves link must reach a milestone directly or through an intent under one, and rules out umbrella and area intents under no milestone; make check passes with the skill copy in step
fields.statement: The plan guide (rhiza guide plan and the rhiza-plan skill) tells the planner that an intention change set must serve a milestone, directly or through an intent under one: the milestone in RHIZA_MILESTONE when set, else the open milestone it fits, never an umbrella or area intent under no milestone

fields.acceptance: A testscript runs a plan run whose interview (fake agent) links the change set serves to an intent under no milestone: the interview step fails with a message naming the change set and the run does not reach review; the same run serving an intent under a milestone passes the step
fields.statement: The plan workflow's interview step fails, loudly, when its completion check finds a planned change set (the intention itself, or each change set serving an intent a record adds) that serves no milestone directly or through an intent under one, naming each such change set and the fix, so the plan never reaches review or the gate

fields.acceptance: A requestsapp unit test files a request with the milestone left at auto and gets argv with no --milestone, then one with a milestone chosen and gets --milestone <id> in the request argv; the entry view shows the milestone field
fields.statement: The requests Rex app's entry has an optional milestone field, defaulting to auto (the planner picks the open milestone it fits); a milestone chosen there is filed as the request's --milestone
